issues.description: In the solution, `Genre.name` is declared as `private let name: String` in `Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift`, but `Client.main()` in `Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift` tries to access it via `genre.name` when printing the inventory. This visibility mismatch causes the solution code not to compile and contradicts the problem statement requirement that a `Genre` consists of a (readable) `name` used for output.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution `Genre` struct, change `private let name: String` to `let name: String` (or provide an equivalent non-private accessor) so `Client` can print `genre.name` as required.
